name: Swan StationPS5
description: Native PlayStation 1 emulator for PS5 based on SwanStation, using the PSXS5 cover-flow frontend. Features Vulkan GPU rendering up to 16x internal resolution, PGXP geometry correction, RetroAchievements, cheats, save states, quick resume, per-game memory cards, multiple themes, configurable controls and DualSense light-gun support.
author: AngelXex
